description: MMS gate: run the inline esm-spec 6.6.5 tests of problems/godunov_norm_2d_eikonal_mms.esm (model GodunovEikonal2DMMS, test mms_eikonal) at the problem's default resolution (NX=NY=64) through each binding's official simulation pathway. Forced-steady eikonal u_t = -S*godunov(u) + S|grad g| with manufactured solution g = sin(2 pi x) + sin(2 pi y); the assertions pin ic wiring (L2_error 0 at t=0 within 1e-9) and bound the first-order error (L2_error < 0.1 at t=0.2). The assertions and their tolerances live in the problem file itself; this manifest only routes the runners. The order-of-accuracy claim is gated by tests/conformance/convergence/godunov_norm_2d_eikonal_mms.

scope_excluded.go: rewrite-only port; no makearray lowering / simulator
scope_excluded.typescript: rewrite-only port; no makearray lowering / simulator
